Chao1 richness estimator for iSNV data

Source: R/diversity.R
chao1ISNV.Rd

Estimates total species (variant) richness using the Chao1 estimator (Chao 1984): $$\hat{S}_{Chao1} = S_{obs} + \frac{f_1^2}{2 f_2}$$ where \(S_{obs}\) is the observed number of variants, \(f_1\) is the number of singletons (variants with altCount == 1), and \(f_2\) is the number of doubletons (variants with altCount == 2). When \(f_2 = 0\), the bias-corrected form is used: \(S_{obs} + f_1 (f_1 - 1) / 2\).

Usage

chao1ISNV(counts, detected)

Arguments

counts

Integer vector. Alternative allele read counts (altCount) for each variant.

detected

Integer scalar. Number of observed variants (\(S_{obs}\)).

Value

Numeric scalar. Chao1 richness estimate.

References

Chao A (1984). Nonparametric estimation of the number of classes in a population. Scand J Statist 11:265-270.

Examples

chao1ISNV(c(1, 1, 2, 5, 10), detected = 5)
#> [1] 7
